notes.title: Say helloaphant to The Elephant Collection!
notes.content:
[h3]Helloaphant, Crush the Castle fans! We have some very big news for you:[/h3]
[h1]The elephant games are back![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41783987/b974e9f83a93b3e4f242dda29eca1c5992faea95.gif[/img]

We've taken ten of jmtb02's elephant-themed Flash classics and bundled them all in a remastered collection just for you! The Elephant Collection features [b]the This is the Only Level games; the Achievement Unlocked games; Elephant Quest; Obey! the Game; Run, Elephant, Run; and Elephant Rave.[/b] Plus, we've included a very lovingly-made metagame to tie the whole collection together!

The Elephant Collection is coming soon to a PC near you.

[h2]Relive your childhood and watch the trailer here:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=-Hf91nIk3zI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Wishlist The Elephant Collection on Steam for updates![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2274110/The_Elephant_Collection/
